priorityList: Maintain Arcane Intellect and pre-cast Glacial Spike and Frostbolt before combat begins.
Use offensive Trinkets, Potions, and Racial cooldowns alongside Frozen Orb or Ray of Frost.
Cast Comet Storm if the Splinterstorm buff is not active.
Cast Flurry if Brain Freeze is active and Thermal Void is not active.
Cast Ice Lance if you have Fingers of Frost active.
Cast Glacial Spike as soon as you have 5 Icicles.
Cast Ice Lance if the target has 6 or more stacks of the Freezing debuff.
Cast Ray of Frost on cooldown.
Cast Flurry if you have a charge available and no Brain Freeze proc.
Cast Frostbolt as your main filler to generate Icicles and Brain Freeze procs.
Use Blink or Shimmer for movement to maintain casting uptime.
Use Ice Nova or Cone of Cold (if talented into Cone of Frost) when forced to move.
Use Ice Lance as a last resort filler spell while moving.
